rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when an action is done in a boring, wearisome way.

example.english: They spoke tediously all morning, and everyone nearly fell asleep.
example.traditional: 佢好悶咁講咗成朝，大家都差啲瞓着。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 mun6 gam3 gong2 zo2 sing4 ciu4 daai6 gaa1 dou1 caa1 di1 fan3 zoek6

rows.note: Use this when the wearisome quality comes specifically from moving or progressing very slowly.

example.english: They packed their things tediously slowly, making us leave late.
example.traditional: 佢慢吞吞咁執嘢，搞到我哋遲咗出門口。
example.jyutping: keoi5 maan6 tan1 tan1 gam3 zap1 je5 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 ci4 zo2 ceot1 mun4 hau2
